$comment: Java agent benchmark questions over the pinned Spring PetClinic REST, Spring RealWorld (MyBatis + DGS), grpc-java examples and Netflix concurrency-limits (Gradle multi-module) samples: routes and RPCs, callers, change impact, dependency injection, Gradle modules, tables and configuration reads. Expected answers were written by reading the pinned source (the controller mapping annotations, the call sites of findBySlug and findByPetId, the implements/extends clauses, the constructor and field injections, the Gradle dependency blocks, the mapper XML and schema SQL, the @Value and @ConditionalOnProperty uses), not from Concentrate output. Scoring as in questions.json.
